must_contain: P4 is the ABDM milestone for a health locker, a PHR application that keeps a person's records for the long term by subscribing to their ABHA address and fetching new records with consent
notes: NHA PHR review, 30 September 2026, cases 7 and 8: P4 had no atom at all, so the panel could not say what it is. Whether P4 is also the route for patient-uploaded records is NHA's to settle; this case asserts only what the P4 page says. Source lines: site/docs/hiecm/v3/milestones/p4.mdx, 'keeps a person's health records for the long term', 'hears about new records through a subscription on their ABHA address, fetches them with consent, and stores them'.
